faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 204DTD Ingenium diesel in the Land Rover Discovery Sport. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a 204DTA engine replace a 204DTD in my Discovery Sport?
faqs.a: Not always directly. The two versions can differ in calibration, emissions equipment and ancillaries, so we check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement for your Discovery Sport.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 204DTD engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery Sport TD4 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery Sport 204DTD engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a DPF, turbo or clutch, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTD engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 2.0 Ingenium engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 204DTD engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 204DTD?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery Sport guide the decision. EGR, DPF, turbo and AdBlue faults can often be repaired on their own. If chain failure has damaged the valves or oil dilution has worn the bearings, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTD engine replacement is usually more sensible.
paragraphs: A replacement engine will only last if the systems around it are healthy. Where relevant, we inspect the DPF, EGR valve and cooler, turbo, intercooler, AdBlue system and cooling circuit, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery Sport 204DTD Faults
engineProblems.description: This later Ingenium diesel usually gives warning signs, and early checks can prevent wider engine damage.

cards.title: Rear Chain and Tensioner Wear
cards.description: A brief rattle after starting, timing fault codes or rough running may point to a worn tensioner or stretched timing chain at the rear of the engine. We measure chain stretch and check timing.

cards.title: Fuel-Diluted Engine Oil
cards.description: A rising oil level or oil service warning may indicate fuel entering the sump when DPF regenerations are repeatedly interrupted by short journeys. We check oil condition and usage patterns.

cards.title: Short-Trip DPF Clogging
cards.description: DPF warnings, reduced power or limp mode often follow frequent short trips, failed regenerations or faulty pressure sensors. We read soot data, test the sensors and assess the filter.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: EGR Cooler Coolant Loss
cards.description: Unexplained coolant loss, white exhaust vapour or EGR fault codes may indicate a leaking EGR cooler or a sticking EGR valve. We pressure-test the system and inspect the cooler.

cards.title: Boost Leaks and Turbo Wear
cards.description: A loss of power, whistling or boost fault codes may come from split intercooler hoses, a sticking vane actuator or turbocharger wear. We test boost control and inspect the turbo.

cards.title: AdBlue Crystallisation and Sensor Faults
cards.description: AdBlue warnings, emissions faults or a restart countdown may come from crystallised AdBlue, a failed NOx sensor, pump or heater. We read fault codes and test the SCR system.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTD Engine: A Complete Later Ingenium Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTD engine is a later version of the 2.0-litre Ingenium diesel, fitted to many TD4 and later diesel Discovery Sport models. With revised calibration and emissions equipment, it can still suffer timing chain wear, oil dilution, DPF blockages and AdBlue faults, leading owners to seek repair or replacement.

The 204DTD code separates this engine from earlier 204DTA units and from longitudinal Ingenium engines in larger models. We identify the correct Discovery Sport TD4 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration before any unit is supplied.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a full rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTD engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
